These SMS, Calling, and Communication Terms (“Communication Terms”) govern text messages, SMS messages, MMS messages, phone calls, voice calls, automated calls, prerecorded messages, push notifications, emails, in-app messages, trusted contact alerts, urgent signal communications, service notices, billing notices, and other communications sent by or through Forward Move, LLC d/b/a My Guardian Link™ (“My Guardian Link,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”).

These Communication Terms apply to all users, including individual users, trusted contacts, emergency contacts, caregivers, parents, guardians, sponsor group members, referral group members, group administrators, business customers, partners, and any person who receives communications from or through My Guardian Link.

By creating an account, providing a phone number, purchasing a membership, joining a group, accepting an invitation, adding trusted contacts, activating an urgent signal, using the Services, or agreeing to receive communications, you agree to these Communication Terms.

These Communication Terms supplement the My Guardian Link Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, Acceptable Use Policy, Master Services Agreement, Data Processing Addendum, subscription terms, group terms, and any other applicable agreement.

My Guardian Link is not a police department, fire department, ambulance service, public safety answering point, government emergency service, emergency medical provider, security company, or law enforcement agency.

My Guardian Link uses communications, including SMS, calls, push notifications, emails, and in-app messages, to support urgent communication, trusted contact notification, location sharing, response coordination, and possible escalation to third-party response resources when available and appropriate.

My Guardian Link does not guarantee that any SMS, call, alert, push notification, email, message, map link, location, data packet, trusted contact notification, coordinator call, central station communication, or public safety communication will be delivered, received, reviewed, answered, acted upon, or result in dispatch, rescue, intervention, prevention of harm, or any specific outcome.
If you can safely call 911 or local emergency services directly, you should do so.
By using My Guardian Link, you may receive or cause others to receive communications related to the Services, including:
Trusted Circle or trusted contact notifications;
Urgent Response Coordinator calls or texts;
Marketing messages, where permitted and consented to.

By providing your phone number, creating an account, checking a consent box, clicking “I Agree,” purchasing a plan, joining a group, accepting an invitation, adding a trusted contact, activating a feature, or otherwise using the Services, you consent to receive communications from or through My Guardian Link.

12. Opting Out Does Not Cancel Your Subscription
Opting out of SMS, calls, emails, push notifications, or other communications does not automatically cancel your My Guardian Link subscription, membership, group participation, or billing obligation.
To cancel your subscription, you must follow the cancellation process described in your account, checkout terms, subscription terms, app store rules, group plan terms, or other applicable agreement.
Even if you opt out of certain communications, My Guardian Link may send or attempt to send communications where permitted by law and reasonably necessary for:
Protection of rights, property, or safety.
Where applicable law limits communications after opt-out, My Guardian Link will comply with those limits.
Any phone number you provide belongs to you, or you have permission to provide it;
You are authorized to receive communications at that number;
You are authorized to add any trusted contact or emergency contact number you provide;
The information you provide is accurate and current;
You will promptly update your account if your phone number changes;
You will not provide false, fake, unauthorized, or third-party phone numbers.
My Guardian Link is not responsible for communications sent to outdated, incorrect, reassigned, or unauthorized phone numbers if you fail to update your account information.
If you receive a My Guardian Link communication in error, contact us at support@myguardianlink.com.
If your phone number changes, is disconnected, is reassigned, or is no longer under your control, you must promptly update your My Guardian Link account.

Failure to update your phone number may result in communications being sent to the wrong person, failed alerts, failed trusted contact notifications, account access issues, privacy issues, or service interruption.
My Guardian Link may suspend or disable communications to a number if it believes the number is invalid, reassigned, unauthorized, or associated with misuse.

If a jurisdiction requires additional consent, we will follow applicable law.

My Guardian Link does not guarantee international SMS, calling, roaming, push notification, Wi-Fi, cellular, emergency escalation, or public safety functionality.

You may not use My Guardian Link communications to:

Mislead central stations or public safety resources;
Violate SMS, calling, privacy, consumer protection, telemarketing, or emergency-service laws.

Violation may result in suspension, termination, records preservation, disclosure to law enforcement or regulators, reimbursement claims, civil liability, administrative penalties, criminal consequences, and other remedies.
